_comment: Premium analysis queries with full joins. Can be triggered by button or intent. LLM can adapt dimensions/filters.

analyses.name: Profit Margin Analysis
analyses.description: Revenue vs cost of goods (VBRP + CKIS) with margin % by product
analyses.base_sql: SELECT v.matnr, COALESCE(m.maktx, v.matnr) AS material_name, SUM(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(v.netwr), '') AS NUMERIC)) AS revenue, COALESCE(c.total_cost, 0) AS cost, SUM(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(v.netwr), '') AS NUMERIC)) - COALESCE(c.total_cost, 0) AS margin, CASE WHEN SUM(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(v.netwr), '') AS NUMERIC)) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(v.netwr), '') AS NUMERIC)) - COALESCE(c.total_cost, 0)) / SUM(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(v.netwr), '') AS NUMERIC)), 2) ELSE NULL END AS margin_pct FROM vbrp v LEFT JOIN VBRK vk ON TRIM(v.vbeln) = TRIM(vk.vbeln) LEFT JOIN MAKT m ON v.matnr = m.matnr AND (m.spras = 'E' OR m.spras IS NULL) LEFT JOIN (SELECT matnr, SUM(CAST(COALESCE(wertn, 0) AS NUMERIC)) AS total_cost FROM CKIS GROUP BY matnr) c ON v.matnr = c.matnr WHERE CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(v.netwr), '') AS NUMERIC) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY v.matnr, m.maktx, c.total_cost ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100
analyses.formula: Margin = Revenue - COGS; Margin % = (Revenue - COGS) / Revenue * 100

analyses.name: Profit Margin by Customer
analyses.description: Revenue vs cost by customer (VBRP + VBRK + KNA1 + CKIS)
analyses.base_sql: SELECT vk.kunag AS customer_number, k.name1 AS customer_name, SUM(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(v.netwr), '') AS NUMERIC)) AS revenue, SUM(COALESCE(c.cost_per_unit, 0) * CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(v.fkimg), '') AS NUMERIC)) AS cost, SUM(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(v.netwr), '') AS NUMERIC)) - SUM(COALESCE(c.cost_per_unit, 0) * CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(v.fkimg), '') AS NUMERIC)) AS margin FROM vbrp v JOIN VBRK vk ON TRIM(v.vbeln) = TRIM(vk.vbeln) LEFT JOIN KNA1 k ON vk.kunag = k.kunnr LEFT JOIN (SELECT matnr, SUM(CAST(COALESCE(wertn, 0) AS NUMERIC)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(COALESCE(menge, 1) AS NUMERIC)), 0) AS cost_per_unit FROM CKIS GROUP BY matnr) c ON v.matnr = c.matnr WHERE CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(v.netwr), '') AS NUMERIC) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY vk.kunag, k.name1 ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

margin_semantic_context: Revenue: VBRP.NETWR (billing item net value). Cost: CKIS.WERTN (cost estimate) or MBEW.STPRS*VBRP.FKIMG. Join VBRP to VBRK on VBELN; VBRP to MAKT on MATNR; VBRP to CKIS/KEKO on MATNR. Margin = Revenue - COGS. Margin % = (Revenue - COGS)/Revenue*100.
